title: Member Case Study Video - Novara Microelectronics (EDG and A*STAR T-Up)
speaker: Operations lead, Novara Microelectronics (dramatised)
summary: Electronics assembly member. Surface-mount lines were producing defects too subtle for visual inspection, and no off-the-shelf software could predict them. Needed a model trained on the company's own inspection data. EDG funded the bespoke AI build and an A*STAR T-Up research secondment supplied the expertise. Defects are now flagged before boards leave the line.

title: Member Case Study Video - Tanjung Precision Works (PSG then EDG)
speaker: Managing director, Tanjung Precision Works (dramatised)
summary: Precision machining member. Was losing tenders on turnaround speed rather than quality: job scheduling ran on spreadsheets, quoting took three days, and machines sat idle through the night shift. A PSG pre-approved scheduling system came first, then a bespoke project let machines run unattended overnight. Quoting is now same day.
